title: Database Foundation
description: Establish global Kysely database integration with full schema types and a single initial migration creating all tables.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines interfaces for organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, notifications, and audit_logs tables
All tables except organizations include tenant_id: string
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at, is_active, and read columns

001_initial.ts creates organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, notifications, and audit_logs tables with all columns, CHECK constraints, foreign keys, ON DELETE rules, and required indexes exactly as defined in the PRD
users.role has CHECK constraint enforcing 'Admin','ProjectManager','Member'
projects.status has CHECK constraint enforcing 'Active','Archived'
tasks.status has CHECK constraint enforcing 'ToDo','InProgress','Completed'
Foreign keys enforce ON DELETE CASCADE exactly as specified in the PRD
Indexes exist on users(tenant_id), projects(tenant_id), tasks(tenant_id, project_id), comments(tenant_id, task_id)
migrate.ts executes all pending migrations on application startup
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Auth Module
description: Implement JWT authentication with registration, login, refresh tokens, global guard, and role decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register marked with @Public()

RegisterDto validates email (@IsEmail, @MaxLength(255)), password (@MinLength(8), @MaxLength(100)), first_name (@IsString, @MaxLength(100)), last_name (@IsString, @MaxLength(100)), organization_name (@IsString, @MaxLength(255))
POST /api/auth/register creates organization and user in a transaction, hardcodes role to 'Member', sets tenant_id = organization.id
POST /api/auth/register returns 201 with { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id }
POST /api/auth/register throws ConflictException if email already exists
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/login marked with @Public()
POST /api/auth/login validates credentials using bcrypt.compare with 12 salt rounds
POST /api/auth/login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id } }
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/refresh marked with @Public() returning new access_token
JWT payload contains { sub, email, role, tenant_id }
JwtStrategy validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id } assigned to req.user
Global JWT guard is registered using APP_GUARD
@Public() decorator bypasses JWT guard
@Roles() decorator sets metadata and RolesGuard enforces exact role match
All queries filter by tenant_id where applicable
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuthModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Organizations Module
description: Allow creation of a new organization with its first Admin user and return JWT tokens.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations marked with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto validates name (@IsString, @MaxLength(255)), email (@IsEmail), password (@MinLength(8)), first_name (@IsString), last_name (@IsString)
POST /api/organizations creates organization and first user with role 'Admin' in a transaction
POST /api/organizations returns 201 with { access_token, refresh_token }
Password is hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Email uniqueness enforced with ConflictException
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Enable Admins to list users with pagination and update user roles within their tenant.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users with pagination query ?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
GET /api/users filters by .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
UsersController exposes PATCH /api/users/:id/role
PATCH /api/users/:id/role requires @Roles('Admin')
UpdateRoleDto has role: @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
PATCH /api/users/:id/role throws ForbiddenException if id === req.user.id
PATCH /api/users/:id/role throws NotFoundException if user not found within tenant
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Provide project creation, listing with pagination, and deletion with tenant isolation.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects
POST /api/projects requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto validates name (@IsString, @MaxLength(255)), description (@IsOptional, @MaxLength(2000)), status (@IsOptional, @IsIn(['Active','Archived']))
POST /api/projects inserts tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id and defaults status to 'Active'
POST /api/projects returns 201 with { id, name, description, status, tenant_id, created_at }
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects with pagination
GET /api/projects returns { data: Project[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
GET /api/projects filters by .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
ProjectsController exposes DELETE /api/projects/:id
DELETE /api/projects/:id requires @Roles('Admin')
DELETE /api/projects/:id deletes project scoped by tenant_id and relies on DB cascade for tasks and comments
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Implement task creation, update with ownership rules, and paginated listing within projects.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/tasks
POST /api/tasks requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager','Member')

CreateTaskDto validates project_id (@IsUUID), title (@IsString, @MaxLength(255)), description (@IsOptional, @MaxLength(2000)), status (@IsOptional, @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])), assigned_to (@IsOptional, @IsUUID)
POST /api/tasks verifies project belongs to tenant using .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
POST /api/tasks verifies assigned_to belongs to same tenant if provided
POST /api/tasks defaults status to 'ToDo'
TasksController exposes PATCH /api/tasks/:id
PATCH /api/tasks/:id allows update only if req.user.role is 'Admin' or 'ProjectManager' OR task.assigned_to === req.user.id
PATCH /api/tasks/:id throws ForbiddenException otherwise
TasksController exposes GET /api/tasks with pagination
GET /api/tasks filters by tenant_id and optionally project_id
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Comments Module
description: Allow authenticated users to create and list comments on tasks with strict tenant and ownership enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: CommentsController exposes POST /api/comments
POST /api/comments requires authentication
CreateCommentDto validates task_id (@IsUUID) and content (@IsString, @MaxLength(2000))
POST /api/comments verifies task belongs to tenant using .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
POST /api/comments sets author_id = req.user.id and tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id
CommentsController exposes GET /api/comments?task_id=uuid with pagination
GET /api/comments filters by tenant_id and task_id
GET /api/comments returns { data: Comment[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
CommentsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
CommentsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide tenant-scoped dashboard metrics and user notifications with read tracking.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard/summary
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns { totalProjects, totalTasks, completedTasks } scoped by tenant_id
All dashboard queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
NotificationsController exposes GET /api/notifications with pagination
GET /api/notifications returns { data: Notification[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } } filtered by tenant_id and user_id = req.user.id
NotificationsController exposes PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read sets read = true only if notification.user_id === req.user.id else throws ForbiddenException
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
DashboardController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
NotificationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
DashboardModule and NotificationsModule are added to app.module.ts imports
